01_prematch: **Pre-match.** Stadium fly-over with team sheets, conditions, difficulty, camera and the exact MacBook control reference. Press any key to kick off.
02_kickoff: **Kick-off under the floodlights.** Broadcast gantry camera, scorebug, player card (sprint reserve D', match energy, muscle strain), radar and the live keyboard input overlay.
03_sprint_dribble: **Sprint dribbling with physical knock-on touches** (Left Ctrl + → held). The ball is never attached: each touch is an impulse sized to the player's real pace.
04_shot: **A shot struck with D.** The launch is solved through the real ball physics (see Part D for the measured speed and spin), then human error is applied to the launch, not the outcome.
05_settings_gameplay: **Settings → Gameplay.** Half length, difficulty, fatigue and every simulation slider with separate User and CPU values.
06_settings_controls: **Settings → Controls.** Click-to-rebind for every slot, swap-on-conflict, and the Keyboard Doctor explaining the macOS Mission Control conflict with Control + Arrow keys.
07_settings_graphics: **Settings → Graphics.** Render scale, frame-rate cap (30/60/120/Uncapped), crowd, turf and weather detail, motion blur, grain, vignette, radar.
08_settings_accessibility: **Settings → Accessibility.** Assisted / Semi / Manual passing and shooting, input overlay, timing-window scale, indicator size, reduce flashing/shake, sprint mode and D + Modifier priority.
09_storm_broadcast: **Storm on the Living Pitch.** Rain streaks and mist, darker soaked turf and puddles forming in low, compacted spots. The HUD reports the pitch state.
10_storm_pro_camera: **Pro camera in the storm.** Eye-line view behind the controlled player; lines are clipped at the camera's near plane.
11_tele_camera: **Tele camera.** High gantry with a long lens for a flattened, tactical view.
12_day_broadcast: **Day match, dry pitch.** Broadcast camera with single sun shadows.
13_goal_celebration: **Goal!** Celebration camera with letterbox, net ripple, crowd roar, chime and PA announcement.
14_half_time_stats: **Half-time statistics.** Possession, shots on target, xG, passes completed, tackles, saves, fouls/offsides/corners, distance covered.
